items.t: Heat pump stops heating in cold weather (recall 22V-050)
items.note: Free over-the-air update. Check your VIN or the software version with Tesla.

items.t: Water entering the rear cargo area
items.job: Reseal liftgate and replace liftgate lamp gaskets
items.note: Tesla has a service bulletin for this; ask if warranty covers it. Dry the carpet fast to avoid mold.

items.t: Front suspension creaks and rattles
items.job: Replace both front upper control arms and align
items.note: Arms come with new ball joints and bushings. Hours include a wheel alignment.

items.t: Loose front suspension bolts from the factory (recalls)
items.job: Inspect and tighten or replace front suspension bolts
items.note: Done free under the recall. Check your VIN with Tesla.

items.t: Suspension knuckle may crack (recall 21V-912)
items.note: Done free under the recall. Check your VIN with Tesla.

items.t: Brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall 21V-387)
items.job: Inspect and tighten brake caliper bolts
items.note: Done free under the recall. Check your VIN with Tesla.

items.t: Seat belt fasteners may not be attached (recalls 21V-388, 21V-389)
items.job: Inspect and attach seat belt anchors
items.note: Done free under the recall. Check your VIN with Tesla.

items.t: Low-voltage 12V battery failure
items.note: Late-2021-on cars use a lithium low-voltage battery, which costs more. May be covered if still under warranty.

items.t: Doors will not open when the 12V battery is weak
items.note: Learn the manual door releases. Lithium low-voltage batteries on later cars cost more.

items.t: Camera cables swapped from the factory (recall 22V-317)

items.note: Done free under the recall. Check your VIN with Tesla.

items.t: Touchscreen can overheat and reboot while fast charging (recall 22V-296)
items.note: Free over-the-air update. Check your VIN or the software version with Tesla.

items.t: Battery crash disconnect may be faulty (recall 23V-434)
items.note: Done free under the recall. Check your VIN with Tesla.
